summary: Tested MilestoneCelebration banner implementation for 4Luis crowdfunding platform. All features working correctly: celebration banner appears on JourneyDetail and Homepage when milestone reached (25%), shows correct message 'O sonho entrou numa nova fase' with chapter title, has dismiss functionality with sessionStorage persistence, and Admin page has no HTML nesting warnings.
passed_tests: MilestoneCelebration: Banner appears on JourneyDetail page when journey has last_milestone_reached=25 and recent last_milestone_at
MilestoneCelebration: Shows '25% ALCANCADO' with sparkle icons
MilestoneCelebration: Shows message 'O sonho entrou numa nova fase'
MilestoneCelebration: Shows chapter title 'O sonho ganha forma' (chapter 2 for 25%)
MilestoneCelebration: Has close button (X) with data-testid='celebration-dismiss'
MilestoneCelebration: Dismiss button successfully hides the banner
MilestoneCelebration: Uses sessionStorage to prevent showing again (key: celebration_journey_china001_25)
MilestoneCelebration: Banner stays hidden after page reload when sessionStorage has the key
MilestoneCelebration: Banner appears on fresh visit (after clearing sessionStorage)
MilestoneCelebration: Appears on Homepage main journey section (below contributions feed area)
Admin page: No HTML nesting warnings (validateDOMNesting) in console
Admin page: Tables render correctly without tr inside span issues
MilestoneProgress: Still working correctly below progress bars (shows 'Faltam 22% para o proximo capítulo')
CheckoutModal: 'Mais popular' badge still visible on €20 option
Backend API: Returns last_milestone_reached (25), last_milestone_at (timestamp), current_chapter (2)
critical_code_review_comments: MilestoneCelebration component well-structured with clear milestone-to-chapter mapping (25%=chapter2, 50%=chapter3, etc.)
Proper 48-hour window check to not show celebrations for old milestones (hoursSince > 48 returns early)
8-second auto-dismiss timeout with cleanup on unmount
Confetti particles use framer-motion with random colors, sizes, and trajectories
Backend correctly sets last_milestone_reached and last_milestone_at in check_and_update_story_chapter()
seed_data_creation: N/A (used existing journey_china001 with milestone data)
context_for_next_testing_agent: MilestoneCelebration banner fully tested and working. The China journey (journey_china001) has last_milestone_reached=25 and last_milestone_at=2026-03-09T18:23:14. The celebration auto-dismisses after 8 seconds and uses sessionStorage to prevent re-showing. To test celebration manually: clear sessionStorage first, then navigate to /journey/journey_china001. Admin page has no HTML nesting warnings. MilestoneProgress component continues to work correctly.
